iti20:2.1: Idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ paduṭṭhacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi,
iti20:2.2: imamhi cāyaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
iti20:2.5: Cetopadosahetu kho pana bhikkhave evam-idhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantīti.
iti20:6.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||10||
